text:
Tom (Marketing): quick sync — we need to lock topic + speaker slots for the May webinar. quick ideas: 'cost-aware LLM serving', 'benchmarks that buyers care about', or a customer panel. thoughts?
Maya (Growth): my vote is benchmarks + a short customer case. benchmarks hook drives signups.
Sean (Content): +1. we should bake a 90s smoke-test demo that shows latency + $/1000 tokens. keeps it tangible.
Tom (Marketing): agree. need 3 speakers: 1 host (internal), 1 product engineer to walk the demo, 1 customer or solutions lead for use-case. who can host?
Rachel (Ops): availability check — greenroom is free May 12 or May 19 afternoons. which works for speakers?
Maya (Growth): May 19 preferred for APAC-friendly time.
Sean (Content): I'll draft 3 short abstracts (one-paragraph each) by EOD tomorrow. can someone confirm we can show the live demo (network + model access)?
Rachel (Ops): SamBot: preflight check for demo infra (embedding proxy + dedicated instance) on May 19 at 14:00 PT.
SamBot (deploy-bot): Preflight scheduled: uptime-check + token quota check for 5m window on 2026-05-19T14:00:00Z. Notifying eng-runtime.
Tom (Marketing): eng-runtime — any objections to a live demo that switches routing between hosted and dedicated mid-demo (to show graceful fallback)? @eng-runtime
Rachel (Ops): eng-runtime is OK as long as we have canary fallback and feature-flagged routing. I'll run a rehearsal with them May 12 if we pick May 19 slot.
Maya (Growth): leads routing: propose an inbound form param `webinar_source=benchmarks_may` so we can segment and route hot leads to AE queue. ops, can you add tag rule?
Rachel (Ops): yes. I'll add Zapier -> SFDC rule for `webinar_source` and auto-tag for the AE team. Also will create a post-webinar survey flow.
Sean (Content): Draft abstracts (short):
- Abstract A: "Practical LLM Performance: What to Measure and Why" — show latency buckets, cost per 1k tokens, and a short demo.
- Abstract B: "Serving Economics: Tunable levers that cut your inference bill" — focus on batching, caching, quantization, routing policies.
- Abstract C: "When to keep models private: customer stories & tradeoffs" — customer panel + short engineering QA.
Tom (Marketing): good set. prefer A+B combo or A+C (if we lock a customer). pick combo by EOD so we can lock speaker invites.
Maya (Growth): pinging a potential customer (AcmeHealth) — they liked our pilot. I'll ask if they'd do a 10-min slot.
Tom (Marketing): run-of-show rough 30m format:
```
00:00-02:00 - host welcome + agenda
02:00-12:00 - demo + benchmarks walk
12:00-20:00 - panel / customer story + Qs
20:00-30:00 - CTAs, next steps, poll
```
We can expand to 45m if customer wants deeper QA.
Sean (Content): for the demo script: short warmup prompt, 1 high-latency case (long context), 1 cost-optimized case (quantized model) and a quick failure+fallback scenario. I'll draft prompts.
Rachel (Ops): rehearsal plan:
- Tech dry run with eng + ops (30m)
- Rehearsal with speakers (45m)
- Backstage run 15m before live
I'll book slots.
Tom (Marketing): speaker ask checklist: short bio, headshot, 3 talking bullets, availability for rehearsal windows (May 12, 14, 17). Please send by end of week.
Maya (Growth): CTA: gated benchmark report + 1:1 demo offer. We should A/B two CTAs across inbound routing. ops: can you route A->AE, B->self-serve playbook?
Rachel (Ops): yes. I'll wire two landing forms and tag flows.
Tom (Marketing): promotion timeline: teaser + registration page 2 weeks out, benchmark snippets week of, reminder day before, final email 1h before. Maya will draft copy.
Sean (Content): also want a short 3-slide follow-up pack (benchmarks, cost tips, how to get started) to auto-send to registrants.
Tom (Marketing): outstanding: pick final topic combo (A+B or A+C), confirm customer slot, speakers' bios, rehearsal calendar. owners: Tom (topic decision), Maya (customer), Rachel (ops/rehearsal infra), Sean (content).
Maya (Growth): I'll follow up with AcmeHealth now.
Rachel (Ops): I'll create the Zapier rule and set rehearsal invites.
SamBot (deploy-bot): Canary test scheduled for 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z; will post results in #eng-runtime.
Tom (Marketing): thanks all — will reconvene Tue EOD for final lock. :thumbsup:
